_comment_port: localhost TCP port the statusline/hook clients send to
_comment_idle: ms of silence after which a 'working' status decays to 'idle'
_comment_session_ttl: ms after which a session with no traffic is assumed gone (force-kill backstop). Long on purpose: an idle-but-open session is silent, and dropping it early puts the weather screen over a live terminal.
_comment_plan_usage: Read the Claude desktop app's plan-usage-history.json so the 5h/7d gauges stay current when Claude Code isn't running. The numbers are account-wide (desktop, web, mobile, Code). Empty path = platform default under the Claude app data dir. freshMs: ignore the file's last sample once it is older than this, since it freezes when the desktop app closes.
_comment_ha: Home Assistant MQTT discovery. discoveryPrefix must match HA's MQTT integration setting (default 'homeassistant').
